overview.description: The Pacer US Cash Cows Bond ETF (MILK) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive Pacer US Cash Cows Bond index. The fund tracks an index of investment grade US corporate bonds, selected based on cash flow yield and margins. The average weighted maturity of the portfolio is approximately 15 years MILK was launched on Dec 17, 2024 and is issued by Pacer.
